_doc.purpose: Agent_Bench patches that remain necessary on the pinned OpenClaw v2026.9.2 runtime.

fields.file: relative path under patch/ to the unified diff
fields.target_glob: glob relative to AB_HARNESS_OPENCLAW_SOURCE_ROOT for content-hashed bundles
fields.target_path: exact relative path used instead of target_glob
fields.chunk_placeholder: placeholder replaced with the resolved bundle hash
fields.idempotent_marker: literal marker proving the patch is present

_doc.migration_policy: Do not backport features already native in v2026.9.2. Keep only Agent_Bench/NSCC integration and raw-serving measurement patches. Every listed patch is required and build failure is intentional when an anchor moves.

patches.summary: route sandbox exec through the Agent_Bench external Singularity bridge
bypass OpenClaw Docker lifecycle because Agent_Bench pre-starts and owns the Singularity task container
route sandbox filesystem operations through the same Agent_Bench external bridge
coerce JSON-stringified nested array/object tool arguments before schema validation for Qwen tool calls
preserve request-level raw OpenAI-compatible serving telemetry used by Agent_Bench measurements
